name: [Demo] P1 Production Incident Response
description: Automated rapid response for critical production outages. Provisions dedicated channels, mobilizes commander, and starts Agora War Room.

actions.name: Create Incident Slack Channel
actions.description: Provisions dedicated channel #incident-{{incident.id}} and pins response runbooks.

actions.name: Generate AI Blast Radius Summary
actions.description: Invokes AI analyzer to synthesize incident context, impact, and initial hypothesis.

actions.name: Provision Agora Video War Room
actions.description: Initializes Agora HD Video War Room session with live transcription.

actions.name: Send Incident Alert Email
actions.description: Dispatches high-priority executive alert with live links.

name: [Demo] Database Outage Escalation Pipeline
description: Escalation pipeline for database and storage outages with delay buffer, state verification, and lead assignment.

trigger.description: Severity Changed to SEV-1 or Critical

actions.name: Post Slack Alert to Infra Channel
Wait Triage Grace Period
actions.description: Simulate brief delay buffer (1.5 seconds) to allow initial health checks.

actions.name: Check Incident Active Status
actions.description: Evaluates whether incident is still active and requires database specialist.

actions.name: Assign Database Specialist Lead
actions.description: Assigns database domain expert to the incident.

name: [Demo] Customer Impact & Status Page Workflow
description: Broadcasts customer status updates, customer-facing notices, and executive summaries upon confirmed customer impact.

actions.name: Publish Advisory to Status Page
actions.description: Updates status.ecosphere.dev with active incident degradation notice.

config.statusMessage: Partial service degradation observed. Engineering team is mitigating.

actions.name: Send Customer Advisory Email
actions.description: Dispatches notice to customer success and enterprise distribution list.

actions.name: Generate Customer Impact AI Summary
actions.description: AI generation of non-technical customer facing impact assessment.

name: [Demo] Incident Resolution & Post-Mortem
description: Decommissions incident resources, archives Slack channel, closes War Room, and synthesizes full AI post-mortem.

actions.name: Archive Incident Slack Channel
actions.description: Marks Slack coordination channel read-only and archives.

actions.name: Generate AI Post-Mortem & Timeline
actions.description: Synthesizes full incident timeline, root cause, timeline events, and action items.

actions.name: Decommission Agora War Room
actions.description: Ends active conference and exports recording transcript.

actions.name: Send Incident Resolution Report
actions.description: Notifies stakeholders and responders that incident has reached full resolution.

name: File Jira Follow-Up Tickets for Uncompleted Actions
description: Creates Jira issues in project PAY and INFRA for remaining post-incident tasks.

actions.name: Generate AI Remediation Action Items
actions.description: Extracts preventative engineering follow-ups and tickets.

actions.name: Log Jira Tickets Created
actions.description: Logs ticket creation events into the audit ledger.

config.message: Created follow-up Jira tickets for incident {{incident.id}}
